# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. It adds variable and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, a reworked singleton lifecycle, and updates every bundled native dependency. This is a breaking release with several v4 API and behavioral changes — check the notes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, loses value-equality** — The property is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo instead of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the type no longer implements IEquatable or the == / != operators. Update any code that compares instances with equality operators or expects the old type name. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is now get-only** — The protected setter was removed. Subclasses that assigned this property must set it another way (e.g. via constructor logic) or drop the assignment if it's no longer needed.
- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default** — new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you assign a typeface. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) and check Typeface.IsEmpty instead of == null. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null** — SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font for drawing, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use Typeface.IsEmpty instead. ([#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android** — All platforms now return SKTypeface.Default for an unmatched family, matching non-Android behavior. For a strict null check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily instead. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737))
- **SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null** — Default resolution moved to the font manager; Android API 36+ now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing. No migration needed unless you relied on it being null. ([#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The underlying native offset is a 32-bit int; out-of-range values used to silently truncate and now throw OverflowException. Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (unrecoverable process termination, not an exception) if the instance or GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion isn't declared as 1.1+. Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to Vulkan 1.1 explicitly; 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in their place. There is no replacement for instance/device ownership tracking. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed** — A new Components field (and GRVkYcbcrComponents struct) was added, changing the struct's layout. Code that manually constructs or relies on the layout of this struct must account for the new field. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m148** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine through milestones 132, 133, and 147 up to the final m148, plus follow-up upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix merges. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color fonts, plus new HarfBuzzSharp APIs** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette support, an HBColor value type, and fixes several HarfBuzzSharp naming-convention violations and missing wrappers. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP output and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Surface drawing and sampling improvements** — Adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and promotes remaining legacy paint text/font-reading members and pre-v4 obsoletes to compiler errors. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access and font-resolution fixes** — Fixes SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan to use RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for offsets, fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when SKPathBuilder is collected first, and moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Platform-specific fixes** — Fixes SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI TabBar, corrects Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks the lifecycle of singleton instances and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and Tizen native asset support** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets and Tizen x64/arm64 native build support, and enables TreatWarningsAsErrors across the binding to catch regressions earlier. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3752))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0, FreeType to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1, expat to 2.8.1/2.7.5, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and libpng to 1.6.58. ([#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0 and adds variable font support, color font palettes, an HBColor value type, and fixes to naming-convention violations and missing API wrappers.
